Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a standard bottom-up DDA LFQ shotgun proteomics study. While the text mentions PTMs (phosphorylation and acetylation) as dynamic modifications in the search parameters and discusses a specific PTM on PGM-1, there was no targeted PTM enrichment (e.g., TiO2 or antibodies) performed; therefore, no PTM-specific workflow modifier is applied.

scope: fresh tissue samples were washed from blood residues with a physiological solution and dipped in 600 μL of protein extraction buffer (25 mM Hepes pH 7.8, 50 mM KCl, beta-Octyl-glucopyranoside 0.2%, 1 mM dithiothreitol) to be homogenized in an ice bath.

Homogenized tissues were centrifuged at 19,000× g, 4 °C for 10 min. The supernatant fraction of each sample was collected, while the insoluble fractions obtained were suspended in 200 µL of hydro-organic solution (0.05% trifluoroacetic acid and 20% acetonitrile), sonicated for 2 cycles of 5 min, and finally centrifuged at 19,000× g, 4 °C, for 10 min. The second supernatant fractions were added to the first ones to obtain a unique extract of soluble proteins and peptides from each sample.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed was a total soluble protein extract derived from homogenized tissue (supernatant and solubilized pellet combined), which corresponds to a whole cell lysate scope.
